notes.title: WHO IS ALAA-MOGUS?
notes.notes:
[b][u]Alaa-Mogus[/u][/b] — an ancient Yakut mythological creature who eats animals and children and, not having eaten enough, wants to eat the main character himself, but he fails.

[list]
[*] In appearance, it is a humanoid monster, can be of enormous height and have an unpleasant voice.

[*] By nature - evil, cruel, greedy, vengeful, and in some cases can be stupid.

[*] At one time it can eat a huge amount of food, livestock, animals, as well as people and children.

[*] They prevent people from living in peace, take away their livestock, harm them, and threaten them.

[*] Very strong. In a one-on-one battle, it is almost impossible to defeat them, so the heroes use cunning and ingenuity, and various assistants help to defeat the monster.

[*] They live next door to people and may have wives and children.
[/list]
